name: SHACL/rule_symbolic
research_q: 研究SHACL约束与Datalog推理规则交互时，如何检测推理可能导致的约束违反，并自动更新原始模式以捕获新推断事实，解决模式静态性与推理动态性矛盾。
limits: process is slow, expensive and error prone
challenging even without taking existential validity rules into account
old_forms: domain experts are needed to define such inference rules
schemas are not static objects, and they can evolve over time

arch_modules.name: Triplestore Schema Model
arch_modules.role: 将SHACL约束抽象为三元组模式、非字面量位置集和存在性有效性规则集

arch_modules.name: Schema Consequence Computation
arch_modules.role: 结合datalog重写和chase算法计算existential-preserving schema consequence
arch_modules.input: Simple schema consequence, Existential validity rules

key_challenge: Critical instance size is very large and inefficient; need a smaller representative instance (sandbox) for efficient reasoning.
